features: 【Christmas Window Silhouette Lights】Santa's Silhouette Light is a wonderful Christmas decoration, pre-lit with bright 28 mini warm white bulbs to create a wonderful Christmas atmosphere. Hang colorful Santas on the windows, say hello with gift bags, and make your Christmas decorations sparkle.

【HIGH QUALITY MATERIAL】Light up Christmas decorations are made of high quality PVC. The pattern adopts double-sided printing and laser engraving technology, the texture is clear, the lines are smooth, and there is no burr. When plugged in, it's three-dimensional and visually pleasing, with lights on windows away from the street.

【Easy to Install】Just put the light string in it, very simple and convenient. Comes with 1 suction cup for hanging. You can hang them anywhere you want. We would like to remind you that this is not a toy and is for decorative use only.
【Battery Powered and Waterproof】IP44 waterproof Halloween light, perfect for indoor and outdoor use. Powered by 2 AA batteries only (batteries not included)

【Ideal Decoration for Indoor and Outdoor】LED Santa Claus Curtain Light has 2 light effect modes - always on and blinking, this is specially designed for Christmas, it is very suitable as Christmas decoration. Just set them up ahead of time to bring a bright and artistic feel to your home space. Soft warm white hanging twinkling lights add warmth and fun. Ideal decoration for home, bedrooms, windows, curtains, doors, walls, gardens, patios, porches, fences, walkways and passages.
